text:
anya: Creating RC 2026.3.1-candidate from branch release/2026.3.1. Artifacts pinned: inference-runtime:sha256:abc123, models:open-mistral-v3.2-quant.

deploy-bot: Build succeeded (artifact 2026.3.1-candidate). Running preflight checks: kv-warm, cfg-validate, smoke. Logs: https://ci.internal/2026.3.1

mike: quick question — what's canary split? planning 10% for 30m unless QA asks to hold.

anya: yes canary 10% for 30m. Start window 2026-03-09T18:15Z. Holding DB migration out of this RC.

elsa: rollback plan: revert to tag stable/2026.3.0, pin model back to open-mistral-v3.1, and flip traffic to fallback region us-west-2 if latency rises. Steps:
```
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=stable/2026.3.0
deploy-bot rollback --tag stable/2026.3.0
``` 
I'll own rollback if needed.

mike: added to runbook. Also adding healthchecks: 5xx rate, p95 > 800ms, token error rate > 0.5% -> auto-roll.

qa-bot: smoke failed: embedding service 502 on one replica. Test: https://qa.internal/smoke/2026.3.1 -> error traces attached.

anya: ack — pausing canary start. Elsa, can you triage? @elsa

elsa: looking now. found egress rule miss for embeddings config. patching and will push hotfix to candidate tag.

deploy-bot: hotfix image pushed as 2026.3.1-candidate-hotfix-1. Preflight re-run queued.

qa-bot: re-smoke passed. All checks green: kv-warm ok, smoke ok, latencies within thresholds.

sheriff: I'm online for the promo window. Have runbook and pager ready. No known infra events in window.

mike: release notes draft: "2026.3.1 — production inference improvements: reduced tokenization latency, upgraded model v3.2 quant. Backwards-compatible API. See full notes: https://docs.internal/releases/2026.3.1"

anya: LGTM. Can we also call out quantization caveat for long-context (>8k) tokens in notes.

mike: done.

anya: giving sign-off to promote. Promo command:
`deploy-bot promote --rc 2026.3.1-candidate --to prod --canary 10% --window 30m`

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Canary traffic 10% -> 300 users. Monitoring: metrics dashboard: https://dash.internal/rc/2026.3.1

deploy-bot: after 30m canary metrics stable -> promoting to 100% across us-west-2 and us-east-1. Rolling update started.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All pods healthy. Post-deploy checks passed.

anya: thanks everyone. Postmortem checklist: collect evals for quality regression for 24h, cost delta snapshot at 1h and 24h.

mike: will publish release notes and send announcement in #announcements after internal review.

elsa: reverting owner to oncall. Thx.

sheriff: closing sheriff handoff at +1h if no alerts.

anya: thread closed.
